new_hypothesis.name: turnover_froth_ceiling
new_hypothesis.mechanism: A high 1h-volume-to-liquidity ratio means a token is being churned far faster than its pool depth can absorb -- hot-potato / wash-trade froth -- so a late copy-entry buys the blow-off top into thin liquidity and gets dumped on; modest turnover relative to depth instead signals genuine, absorbable accumulation. Corroborated externally by the pump.fun graduation-predictor literature (arXiv 2602.14860): tokens that reach a vSol level in FEW big-fill trades (10-50) graduate far more than 500+ churn-trajectory tokens -- few-large-fills = conviction, many-small-churn = froth.
new_hypothesis.persistence: vol_liq_ratio is a structural/behavioral composition signal (turnover intensity vs pool depth), not a single price number snipers race to front-run; bots optimize entry latency and absolute breadth, almost none compute a turnover-to-depth CEILING, so the froth-late-entry trap stays unpriced. The relationship is regime-robust because thin-pool churn dumps in BULL and CHOP alike.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Universal entry skip in _process_signal: SKIP any candidate whose vol_liq_ratio (already logged on every buy as volume_h1/liquidity, also surfaced as the precomputed vol_liq_ratio field) is >= ~12 (froth zone). Conservative tiering from the data: vol_liq_ratio<4 = green (73% WR), 4-10 = neutral, >=10 = red (24% WR). Start the ceiling at 12 (clear froth) and log a would-have outcome on every skip so the brain can audit blocked winners. Optional 2-feature sharpen: require vol_liq_ratio<10 AND mcap_at_entry>=$500k -> WR 63% (+3.3%, n=19) in sample.
new_hypothesis.data_required: ZERO new data infrastructure -- vol_liq_ratio and volume_h1/liquidity are ALREADY captured on every buy record in sol_trade_log.json. Pure filter logic on existing fields. (mcap_at_entry, also already logged, for the optional 2-feature variant.)
new_hypothesis.evidence: Own enriched closed cohort N=52 (~2026-06-09+ buys with gt_* populated; WC 32, BS 13, CB 4, CMS 3): vol_liq_ratio bucketed <4 -> WR 0.733 mean pnl +3.7% (n=15); 4-10 -> WR 0.375 (n=8); >=10 -> WR 0.241 mean pnl -6.4% (n=29, HALF the book). Direction holds inside EVERY strategy with both buckets: wallet_convergence 0.53 vs 0.31, bear_strength 1.00 vs 0.18, consensus_boost 1.00 vs 0.00. In a tercile sweep vol_liq_ratio was the single strongest separator (bottom-tercile WR 0.71 +3.3 vs top-tercile WR 0.29 -5.5). Runner-up confirmations: price_change_5m<=0 at entry WR 0.524 (n=21) vs pc5m>2 WR 0.176 -7.3% (n=17) [do not chase the 5-min up-tick]; mcap_at_entry<$500k WR 0.18 (n=11) vs >$2M WR 0.56 (n=16).

request_responses.finding: NULL VERDICT -- do NOT implement a net-sell (gt_sellers_m5 > gt_buyers_m5) skip gate, neither BS-specific nor universal. (1) FALSIFIED by counter-example: JOBY (+15.99% bear_strength WIN) had a NET-SELL book (gt_buyers_m5=11, gt_sellers_m5=15, net+4) -- the SAME imbalance magnitude as catastrophic-stop WOC (net+4). A naive net-sell gate blocks a 16% winner. Seed losses confirmed net-sell (BROTCHEN net+17, WOC net+4, TYGR net+1) and winner BOUNTYWORK confirmed net-buy (net-29), but JOBY breaks the separation. (2) NOT UNIVERSAL -- the sign INVERTS on the other strategies: net-sell cohort OUT-performs net-buy on chop_momentum_scalp (50% vs 0%) and wallet_convergence (23.1% vs 14.3%), so a _process_signal gate would harm two strategies. (3) SAMPLE TOO THIN: only 13 of 37 BS closes are gt-populated (4 of 8 catastrophic, 3 of 12 wins) -- the directional BS read (net-sell WR 14.3% n=7 vs net-buy 40.0% n=5) is below any defensible min-sample. If revisited later, the candidate discriminator is magnitude-of-imbalance + bundle_detected, NOT the raw net-sell sign, but current N is insufficient to fit even that. Revisit at >=30 gt-populated BS closes. NOTE: the run separate microstructure mining suggests these BS losses may instead be a TURNOVER-FROTH (high vol_liq_ratio) phenomenon -- see new_hypothesis turnover_froth_ceiling, a cleaner cross-strategy axis than net-sell.
